prompt:
You are the executive responsible for new-product development decisions at a company in Korea. Read the situation below and make a decision.

[Company]
- (four firm attributes drawn from a KIS respondent are redacted in the public copy; persona id P016, see personas_public.csv)

[The project]
- Your company is developing a new product, and one rival is developing a comparable product. Development consists of 3 stages; once all 3 stages are completed the product is launched immediately.
- At most 3 development periods remain. In each period, each company chooses one of the following:
  - Continue: cost 0.8 billion won, 50% chance of completing one stage in that period
  - Accelerate: cost 2.5 billion won, 80% chance of completing one stage in that period
  - Stop: cost 0, abandon the development for good and redirect the remaining budget and staff to the existing business
  The cost is incurred in that period whether or not the stage is completed. The rival has the same options with the same costs and probabilities, and acts to maximise its own profit.
- Expected profit: about 10 billion won if you launch before the rival, about 3 billion won if you launch after the rival has launched, and 6.5 billion won each if both launch in the same period. If you do not complete within the 3 periods, there is no profit. (Profit figures are before development costs.)

[Current situation — decision for the first period]
- Your company has completed 2 of the 3 stages; the rival is understood to have completed 1. You are one stage ahead.
- How many stages the rival has completed is an estimate from industry information; about 4 times in 10 it is off by one stage. The rival's picture of your progress is equally imprecise.
- There is no possibility that a new competitor enters your market.

[Decision]
Choose one of the following for this period. In the next period you will decide again with new information.
A. Continue: spend 0.8 billion won this period on development (50% chance of completing one stage this period)
B. Accelerate: spend 2.5 billion won this period to speed up development (80% chance of completing one stage this period)
C. Stop: abandon the development now for good (no further cost) and redirect the remaining budget and staff to the existing product business

Answer only in this JSON format and write nothing else:
{"decision": "A" or "B" or "C", "reason": "at most two sentences"}

reason: With one stage remaining and a likely one-stage lead, the 50% option preserves a strong chance of launching first at much lower cost. Acceleration’s additional success probability does not justify the extra 1.7 billion won this period.
